title: Mysteria Friends
synopsis:
Mysteria Academy is a prestigious magic school that teaches without discrimination to the three factions (humans, gods and demons) who otherwise are usually at battle with each other. This anime follows the daily lives of two young women at the academy, Anne, the princess of Mysteria, and the dragon princess Grea. 

(Source: Anime News Network)

episodes.title: Anne and Grea
episodes.synopsis: Human princess Anne and dragonborn princess Grea attend Mysteria Academy, a prestigious school for the magical arts.

episodes.title: Agony of Grea
episodes.synopsis: When Grea falls ill with a strange fever, it’s up to Anne to find a cure in the depths of Mysteria Academy’s forbidden library.

episodes.title: Princess's Holiday
episodes.synopsis: It's a girls' day out, so the girls go shopping! But what awaits Grea and Anne at the end of a dark and mysterious alley…?

episodes.title: Test Time
episodes.synopsis: Not even a princess is exempt from loneliness. Today, the distance between Anne and her peers has never felt so large.

episodes.title: Academy Down
episodes.synopsis: Monsters have invaded Mysteria Academy — and Grea is trapped inside the school! Anne wants to come to her rescue… but does Grea actually need saving?

episodes.title: Floating at Sea
episodes.synopsis: White sand, blue waves, clear sky… it’s the perfect day for the beach! But Anne seems reluctant to get in the water. Can Grea help her face her fears?

episodes.title: Hide-and-Seek
episodes.synopsis: Anne is determined to find Grea when they play hide and seek in the library after hours. Too bad Grea is frustratingly good at hiding…
